item.title: Getting the OSCP Certification: 'Offensive Security Certified Professional' (PEN-200) review
item.author: quactv
item.description: 28-4-2021 / 21 Year Old Today I’m sitting here writing down these thoughts right after receiving the email telling me I had passed Offensive Security’s OSCP exam. This is just a simple post so I can share my thoughts, feelings and the journey I took to earn the OSCP certification on my first attempt. It was a whole grueling process, three months of giving it my all. What is OSCP?
